results.name: The seated poet
results.description:
The seated poet, Monte Calvo, 2nd century A.D., Marble, Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek (Copenhagen, Denmark). Made with Memento Beta (now ReMake) from AutoDesk.

Ann old man clad only in the shaggy cloak is seated singing as he strikes his lyre and taps his foot to the rhythm. This old poet was placed together with the statues of Anacreon and the Nine Muses.

For more updates, please follow @GeoffreyMarchal on Twitter.

results.name: Attachment depicting a seated man on an elephant
results.description:
**Collection:** Roman Archeology Dept.
 
**Inv.-No.:** [CAR-M-8011](https://www.online.landessammlungen-noe.at/objects/1474038)

**Material:** Bronze 

**Dimensions:** 7,4 x 8,6 cm

**Dating:** 1st-4th century AD

The bearded man sits behind the elephant's head. His legs are spread, and he wears shoes that reach up to his ankles, suggested with fine engraving. Locks of hair forms a neatly styled haircut with a parting. The man wears a short tunic and a long, folded cloak wrapped around both arms. The right lower arm is broken off. Only the folded head of the elephant with its raised trunk and neck is depicted. The perforated base is only partially preserved. Many anatomical details, as well as the clothing, are rendered plastically and partially suggested with fine engraving.

This object was digitized through the 'Kulturerbe digital' program of the Federal Ministry for Arts, Culture, Public Service and Sport.

results.name: Seated man with facial decoration
results.description:
Ceramic whistle in the form of a male figure seated with legs crossed in front and hands resting on the knees. The figure displays well-preserved polychromy: the skin is painted in reddish tones, while the jewelry elements show traces of blue pigment. The character wears a decorated-edge loincloth or skirt, wristbands and anklets, as well as a necklace made of small bells. He also wears a headdress made of knotted cloth. The face features scarification designs on the cheeks and around the mouth, which could be mistaken for a beard. This facial decoration may be linked to identity, status, or ritual symbolism.

 IDAEH Cultural Property No. 1.2.144.1411
 
www.fundacionrutamaya.org

Special thanks to the staff of La Ruta Maya Foundation for their hard work on this project.

3D model made in RealityScan; Total # of images: 370

results.name: Pompeii - VI.8.23 - Mosaic Fountain
results.description:
This mosaic fountain is built up against the back wall of a small, lavishly painted, peristyle in the Casa Della Fontana Piccola (VI.8.23). It was scanned as part of the 2022 Pompeii Water and Sanitation Project field school run by the University of Missouri. The facade of the fountain is covered in lavish mosaics bordered by seashells, with a small pool in front. In the pool is a pedestal; on the right a bronze statue of a seated man, and on the left the remains of a small marble statue. The house nextdoor (VI.8.22) is the house of the Fontana Grande, with a slightly larger fountain (Very creative naming!). More information and photos can be seen on Pompeii in Pictures, here: http://www.pompeiiinpictures.com/pompeiiinpictures/r6/6%2008%2023%20p1.htm

The model was generated in Agisoft Metashape from 765 photos taken using a Nikon Z5. Photo alignment was run on high, model generated on medium - model has been decimated for export, and made manifold for 3D printing.

results.name: Henry VII Chapel Seat
results.description:
An example of one of the hinged oak seats (misericord) in the Henry VII Chapel in Westminster Abbey, London.

This seat is second from the west, on the north side, lower section. The wood carving depicts:

"David and Goliath. David stands beside the headless body of the giant and an elaborate, but damaged, scene probably showed him returning in triumph bearing the head of Goliath. On the right side Goliath is shown peering over the walls of a castle and on the left David discharges his sling with a man and woman looking on from a castle."

https://www.westminster-abbey.org/about-the-abbey/history/misericords

26 photos taken in June 2021 with a Sony a6000 and processed in Reality Capture.
